payload.name: Unauthenticated Host-Less Proxy Control Plane Endpoints
payload.description: Matching proxy control-plane routes (/holon, /holon/api/metrics, /_holon/metrics, /holon/api/mode, /_holon/mode) in src/holon_coherence/proxy/steps/serve_dashboard.py solely on URL path without verifying both the target host (loopback/local control plane) and an authentication token allows any proxied client, SSRF vector, DNS-rebound origin, or cross-origin page (especially with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *) to read live telemetry or mutate proxy state such as addon.default_passive and addon.wire_log_dir.
payload.action: Gate all /holon and /_holon control-plane handlers in src/holon_coherence/proxy/steps/serve_dashboard.py on strict loopback/control-plane host validation via src/holon_coherence/proxy/routing.py, require an authenticated bearer or session token managed by src/holon_coherence/commands/web_token.py (stored 0o600), avoid wildcard CORS headers on control endpoints, and cover host/auth rejection paths in tests/proxy/test_dashboard.py and tests/commands/test_web_token.py.
symptoms: GET /holon/api/metrics or POST /holon/api/mode succeeds when sent to an arbitrary remote Host header routed through the proxy.
Unauthenticated POST /holon/api/mode can toggle addon.default_passive or redirect addon.wire_log_dir.
Control-plane responses emit 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *', permitting cross-origin browser reads of proxy metrics.
Dashboard or control API handlers inspect ctx.path_clean without checking host locality or token credentials.
